name: oie-web-client
description: OIE Web Client monorepo: the web administrator app + the @oie/web-* framework packages plugin authors build against.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p type-tests/tsconfig.json && tsc -p web-administrator/tsconfig.json && tsc -p web-administrator/tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p web-administrator/tsconfig.plugins.json && tsc -p web-administrator/tsconfig.views.json && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm test -w web-administrator && node --test tools/*.test.mjs && npm run i18n:check
scripts.i18n:check: node tools/i18n-extract.mjs --check && node tools/i18n-check.mjs && node tools/i18n-literals.mjs
scripts.build:i18n-test: npm run build -w web-administrator && npm exec -w web-administrator -- vite build --mode i18n-test
